description: Regression cases for the guidance bundle: real defects found while building Phase 3 (each note records the failure and the fix). Never remove a valid case because the implementation changed.

cases.query: tvOS documentary player: transport controls and subtitle picker
cases.note: 2026-09-09 Phase 3: tv-player-controls was the single most relevant record (score equal to the top) but never entered the bundle because the interaction concern was already covered by a weak core pattern and the cap was reached before its concept ids were processed. Fixed: a rule/anti-pattern scoring >= 0.9 x top with lexical evidence >= 0.5 is always taken as a guardrail.

cases.query: landing page for a compliance automation product, web
cases.note: 2026-09-09 Phase 3: the 'component' concern was satisfied by search-filter-feedback (a rule tagged component) because rules were preferred for every concern. Fixed: build concerns (component/structure/navigation/brand/data-display) prefer core kinds and require lexical evidence.

cases.query: marketing landing page for a bakery, web
cases.note: 2026-09-09 Phase 3: a marketing page received five guardrails including generic states rules. Fixed: states is recommended (not required) for marketing pages without data/forms, and recommended coverage only fills the bundle to 6.

cases.query: the streaming app shows an upgrade pop-up on every launch, users hate it
cases.note: 2026-09-09 Phase 3: 'users hate it' / 'on every launch' were not recognised as problem statements, so the request defaulted to create and the anti-pattern was never surfaced. Fixed in lexicon problems.general and anti-interruptive-upsell keywords.

cases.query: Build the parcel pickup confirmation screen for our Android courier app
cases.note: 2026-09-09 Phase 3: 'Android' alone produced no platform, so no input matrix concepts were required. Fixed: platforms_inferred lexicon group gives mobile as INFERRED (not KNOWN) unless the wording says Android TV / Fire TV / Google TV.

cases.query: web project board with cards you can drag between columns
cases.note: 2026-09-09 Phase 3: on web all inputs are INFERRED, so no operability concept was required and drag-only boards shipped without keyboard alternatives. Fixed: the web platform always requires keyboard navigation, hover independence and visible focus.

cases.query: add a confirmation toast after saving on the web settings page
cases.note: 2026-09-09 Phase 3: the settings screen was treated like a form (validation errors + IME required), inflating a simple toast task to 8 records. Fixed: settings/notification/dialog make feedback recommended, not required; screen-level components carry the structure concern. 2026-09-09: max_bundle raised 6 -> 7. With high-relevance rules admitted as guardrails, states-persistence-and-session (saving -> saved as quiet inline status, not a toast per keystroke) joins this bundle and is directly on task; the case's 6 was a guess about compactness, 7 keeps the compactness intent (soft cap 6 for recommended coverage still holds).

cases.query: mobile app for rural health workers that must work offline and sync later
cases.note: 2026-09-09 Phase 3: low-bandwidth made 'environment' required but no admissible record carried the concern on mobile (the field-use rule is tagged outdoor/gloves). Fixed: states-offline-and-sync declares environment as well as states.

cases.query: review the accessibility of the stock adjustments page
cases.note: 2026-09-09 torture test p3-winui-erp-audit: inspect_project DPAD_RE ended in '|isTV' under re.I, so 'ListView' marked every WinUI/WPF/Avalonia project as a TV with a remote (TV rails, safe-area guardrails, capped density, direction violations). Fixed with a word boundary.

cases.query: product page and checkout for our web store; must convert well on phones
cases.note: 2026-09-09 torture test p3-ecommerce-web: web + 'on phones' was reported AMBIGUOUS as two competing platforms. It is one responsive web UI; requirements_status now accepts web with mobile/tablet and adds responsive as a secondary mode.

cases.query: product detail page for our outdoor gear web store
cases.note: 2026-09-09 torture test p3-ecommerce-web: the bare word 'outdoor' (a product adjective) created an outdoor environment and pulled the sunlight/gloves guardrail into a PDP bundle. Environment phrases now need usage wording (outdoors, outdoor use, bright sunlight...).

cases.query: prescription pick-up kiosk for a pharmacy, public touch screen in the store
cases.note: 2026-09-09 torture test p3-kiosk-pharmacy: 'in the store' (a location) made product=ecommerce and drove hero imagery and cross-fade motion into a kiosk direction. Bare 'store' removed from the ecommerce lexicon; store phrases kept.

cases.query: Flutter defect report form must stay usable with the on-screen keyboard open
cases.note: 2026-09-09 torture test p3-mobile-flutter-field: the most task-specific rule scored well in search but never entered the bundle because generic platform concepts filled the cap first. Fixed: high-relevance rules (>= 0.75 x top, lexical >= 0.4) become guardrails before coverage picks, and coverage is a global greedy set cover.

cases.query: pharmacy prescription pick-up kiosk: identify the patient and show ready prescriptions
cases.note: 2026-09-09 torture test p3-kiosk-pharmacy: shared-device-privacy was rank 7 in search yet absent from the bundle while privacy was a required concern on a healthcare kiosk. 2026-09-09 (Phase 4): widened to any record carrying the shared-device and masking concepts; comp-kiosk-keypad (masked PIN entry) and kiosk-public-use now legitimately cover them for an identify step, so the assertion is on concepts, not one record.

cases.query: sign-in screen with an activation code
cases.note: 2026-09-09 torture tests p3-tvos-swiftui and p3-android-tv-compose: every Apple project was tagged mobile and a leanback-only Android app kept mobile from its Compose dependency, so clear TV requests became AMBIGUOUS. Inspector now reads Apple targets (tvOS/iOS/macOS) and drops mobile when the only launcher is leanback.

cases.query: WPF purchase order lines grid, clerks enter 200 lines a day with the keyboard
cases.note: 2026-09-09 torture test p3-erp-desktop-dotnet: comp-data-entry-grid (the most specific record) was pruned as 'same category' as comp-data-table. A second core record of the same category is now allowed when it scores >= 0.85 x top and carries concept ids the bundle does not yet cover.

cases.query: refactor the defect report form so it works with the keyboard open
cases.note: 2026-09-09 real project p4-13/p4-14: DPAD_RE matched 'dPad' inside AnimatedPadding (case-insensitive substring), tagging a Flutter app as TV and filling five of eight bundle slots with TV records. Fixed with a word boundary; fixture carries the real widget.

cases.query: accessibility audit and fix of the identify step of the pick-up kiosk
cases.note: 2026-09-09 real project p4-09: the inspector reports 'web' for an HTML kiosk and the request said kiosk, producing a platform conflict and AMBIGUOUS. Web technology is the normal substrate of kiosk and TV apps; no conflict is recorded.

cases.query: add keyboard shortcuts and a command bar to the existing stock adjustments page without changing its navigation or theme
cases.note: 2026-09-09 real project p4-03: 'without changing its navigation' made navigation a component target and refactor a mode; 'its theme' was not a preserve target. Reference clauses are stripped before target detection; preserve targets accept possessives and up to four intervening words.

cases.query: add a compare-to-last-week view to the energy dashboard KPIs, keeping the existing top bar and light theme
cases.note: 2026-09-09 real project p4-04: 'keeping the existing top bar and light theme' left intent.preserve empty and 'KPI' mapped to a finance product. Fixed in the preserve grammar and the lexicon.

cases.query: add a product listing page with filters to our outdoor gear web store, matching the existing product and checkout pages
cases.note: 2026-09-09 real project p4-06: 'matching the existing product and checkout pages' made checkout a target screen and pulled the checkout record into a listing-page bundle.

cases.query: facility managers don't notice new alerts; make exceptions the first thing they see on the dashboard without redesigning it
cases.note: 2026-09-09 real project p4-05: an alerts task had feedback only recommended, so live-region and one-action guidance were absent; 'without redesigning it' was not a preservation. Alerts are a job with required concepts; 'without redesigning it' preserves navigation/layout/system.

cases.query: polish this existing light-theme WPF purchase-order screen: inconsistent spacing in the toolbar and status bar, and validation errors are hard to read
cases.note: 2026-09-09 real project p4-07: 'validation errors are hard to read' demanded no validation or contrast concept, and the low-budget direction proposed a dashboard grid with data graphics for a polish task. Validation/readability wording now demands the concepts; low-budget slots the task does not mention stay as implemented.

cases.query: polish the billing settings page so plan cards, seat table and invoice history feel consistent with the rest of the admin, without changing navigation or theme
cases.note: 2026-09-09 real project p4-01: no guidance said 'reuse the project's own primitives' for a consistency polish, and the direction proposed table-first layout and toolbar commands for a settings page. In an existing repository polish/refactor now demand process.reuse_first, and low-budget slots stay as implemented.

cases.query: Freezing a card happens the instant you touch the switch.
cases.note: 2026-09-16 Phase 6 implemented project round (research/phase6-projects, frozen c3 → fix in c4): p6-16: mode fell to create on a present-tense defect report, the payment card was read as a card component and card-none entered the bundle (contradicts-codebase); critical recall 0. Routed: mode (present tense 'happens'), candidate compatibility (paymentcard trap already existed but mode/create path bypassed it), expected concepts ('instant' → confirmation).

cases.query: The confirmation screen prints the receipt but never says the pick-up is complete.
cases.note: 2026-09-16 Phase 6 implemented project round (research/phase6-projects, frozen c3 → fix in c4): p6-29: 'confirmation screen' resolved to a form screen and pulled a keypad, a wizard and a dialog (wrong-screen); critical recall 0.33. Routed: requirements (screen sense) → completion-screen trap; expected concepts ('never says' → live status).

cases.query: Purchase order screen: operators want to do the whole entry without touching the mouse.
cases.note: 2026-09-16 Phase 6 implemented project round (research/phase6-projects, frozen c3 → fix in c4): p6-18 / p6-23 / p6-15: table.tabular_figures was critical from the ERP / finance product alone, so the typography rule entered as a critical carrier on keyboard and IME tasks (generic ×7 across the round). Routed: criticality (product baseline is priority 2 unless the request names numbers or a grid).

cases.query: VoiceOver reads the streak ring as "image".
cases.note: 2026-09-16 Phase 6 implemented project round (research/phase6-projects, frozen c3 → fix in c4): p6-14: keyboard operability was demanded as critical on a touch-only VoiceOver task and interaction-drag-drop entered as its GENERIC carrier (wrong-screen ×4 across the round). Routed: criticality (accessibility review demands keyboard only where a keyboard exists); candidate compatibility (record word gate: drag-drop needs drag wording).

cases.query: Add a status bar with the last sync time and any failed postings.
cases.note: 2026-09-16 Phase 6 implemented project round (research/phase6-projects, frozen c3 → fix in c4): p6-19: 'last sync time' produced no concept although states-offline-and-sync was the top search hit; critical recall 0.33. Routed: expected concepts (aliases).

cases.query: Add a Welsh language option to the ticket machine.
cases.note: 2026-09-16 Phase 6 implemented project round (research/phase6-projects, frozen c3 → fix in c4): p6-32: 'language option' was not an i18n alias, so the i18n record (top search hit) never became a candidate. Routed: expected concepts.

cases.query: Nobody can find the API keys section; it is buried at the bottom of the settings page.
cases.note: 2026-09-16 Phase 6 implemented project round (research/phase6-projects, frozen c3 → fix in c4): p6-01: comp-plan-comparison entered on SaaS product evidence alone (wrong-screen) and 'buried' was not a hierarchy alias. Routed: candidate compatibility (product-only fit is GENERIC for composites; plan-comparison word gate); expected concepts.

cases.query: The cart page: removing an item happens instantly and people do it by accident.
cases.note: 2026-09-16 Phase 6 implemented project round (research/phase6-projects, frozen c3 → fix in c4): p6-04: the named defect (accidental destructive action) produced no concept while checkout-screen baselines pulled a sticky bar and a delivery-promise rule (wrong-screen). Routed: expected concepts ('by accident' / 'instantly'); criticality (narrow task demotion once the concept is named).

cases.query: Make the dashboard tell the manager which items need reordering today.
cases.note: 2026-09-16 Phase 6 implemented project round (research/phase6-projects, frozen c3 → fix in c4): p6-10: two chart records took the core while data-exceptions-first sat in the optional layer and interaction-drag-drop entered as a GENERIC carrier. Routed: criticality (dashboard chart-form demand is a baseline unless charts are named); bundle selection (GENERIC admission needs the record's primary concept).
